in_hebrew.name: Marleen
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Marleen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek name 'Maryas' meaning 'resembling Mary'. The suffix 'leon' means 'lion'. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus, so Marleen is a name for a girl reminiscent of Mary and her courageous strength.

in_greek.name: Marleen

in_greek.long_meaning: Marleen είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek name 'Maryas' meaning 'resembling Mary'. The suffix 'leon' means 'lion'. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus, so Marleen is a name for a girl reminiscent of Mary and her courageous strength.

in_latin.name: Marleen
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mary's Lion
in_latin.long_meaning: Marleen est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek name 'Maryas' meaning 'resembling Mary'. The suffix 'leon' means 'lion'. In the Bible, Mary is the mother of Jesus, so Marleen is a name for a girl reminiscent of Mary and her courageous strength.
